name: Warm Rice Pudding with Apple, Cranberry & Ginger Compote

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add milk, sugar, and vanilla; stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
710 ml whole milk
⅓ cup brown sugar
1 tbsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a simmer, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 Gala apples
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ oranges

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and medium dice apples.
Preheat another medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add apples, ginger, cranberries, sugar, cinnamon, and salt to the saucepan; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ cup dried cranberries
⅓ cup brown sugar
¾ tsp cinnamon
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Juice oranges into the pan with the fruit and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until apples are tender and the sauce has thickened, 6-7 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Once the rice is done, remove from the heat. Add cream, stir to combine, and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
To serve, divide rice pudding between bowls and top with fruit compote. Enjoy!
